vendor.quote: between Amazon Web Services, Inc. and its affiliates (“AWS”, “us” or “we”)

covered_services.quote: This Amazon CloudFront Service Level Agreement (“SLA”) is a policy governing the use of Amazon CloudFront

plan.missing_reason: The SLA does not name separate plans; no 'Standard' plan is mentioned.

uptime_commitment_pct.quote: make Amazon CloudFront available with a Monthly Uptime Percentage (defined below) of at least 99.9% during any monthly billing cycle

timezone.missing_reason: The SLA does not specify a time zone for measuring the month.

value.description: Error Rate is internal server errors returned by Amazon CloudFront divided by total requests in each five minute period, per account; errors arising from SLA Exclusions are not counted. Monthly Uptime Percentage is 100% minus the average of the Error Rates across all five minute periods in the monthly billing cycle.

downtime_definition.quote: “Error Rate” means: (i) the total number of internal server errors returned by Amazon CloudFront divided by (ii) the total number of requests during that five minute period. […] “Monthly Uptime Percentage” is calculated by subtracting from 100% the average of the Error Rates from each five minute period in the monthly billing cycle.

credit_tiers.quote: | Less than 99.9% but greater than or equal to 99.0% | 10% | […] | Less than 99.0% but greater than or equal to 95.0% | 25% | […] | Less than 95.0% | 100% |

credit_basis.quote: Service Credits are calculated as a percentage of the total charges paid by you for Amazon CloudFront for the billing cycle in which the error occurred in accordance with the schedule below.

credit_cap.missing_reason: The source states no explicit cap percentage. The highest tier is 100% of charges, but no cap is stated.

min_credit.quote: A Service Credit will be applicable and issued only if the credit amount for the applicable monthly billing cycle is greater than one dollar ($1 USD).

value.description: Suspension described in Section 6.1 of the AWS Agreement
Factors outside AWS's reasonable control, including force majeure events or Internet access or related problems beyond the demarcation point of Amazon CloudFront
Results from any actions or inactions of the customer
Results from the customer's equipment, software or other technology
AWS suspension and termination of the customer's right to use Amazon CloudFront in accordance with the AWS Agreement
Results from exceeding usage limits stated in the Amazon CloudFront documentation
Results from use of an origin server other than Amazon S3

exclusions.quote: (i) that result from a suspension described in Section 6.1 of the AWS Agreement; (ii) caused by factors outside of our reasonable control, including any force majeure event or Internet access or related problems beyond the demarcation point of Amazon CloudFront; (iii) that result from any actions or inactions of you; (iv) that result from your equipment, software or other technology; (v) arising from our suspension and termination of your right to use Amazon CloudFront in accordance with the AWS Agreement; (vi) that result from exceeding usage limits stated in the Amazon CloudFront documentation; or (vii) that result from use of an origin server other than Amazon S3

prerequisites.quote: To receive a Service Credit, you must submit a claim by [opening a case in the AWS Support Center.]

claim_window.quote: the credit request must be received by us by the end of the second billing cycle after which the incident occurred

claim_procedure.quote: you must submit a claim by [opening a case in the AWS Support Center.] To be eligible, the credit request must be received by us by the end of the second billing cycle after which the incident occurred and must include: i. the words “SLA Credit Request” in the subject line; ii. the dates and times of each incident of non-zero Error Rates that you are claiming; and iii. your request logs that document the errors and corroborate your claimed outage

remedy_form.quote: Service Credits are calculated as a percentage of the total charges paid by you for Amazon CloudFront for the billing cycle in which the error occurred […] We will apply any Service Credits only against future Amazon CloudFront payments otherwise due from you.
